name: Chat history, renaming — empty
summary: The field cleared, caret at the start. Save is still drawn active, which is the state that decides whether an empty name can be committed.

looseEnds.title: An empty name is savable as drawn
looseEnds.detail: With the field empty, Save carries exactly the same treatment it has with a full title. Nothing states whether the empty name is rejected, whether the chat reverts to its generated title, or whether it is saved blank.
looseEnds.ask: Define the empty case, and draw Save disabled if that is the answer.

looseEnds.title: The emptied field collapses to 2px
looseEnds.detail: With no value the Contents frame hugs to 2px wide and the separator inside it still measures 370px, overflowing its parent. It renders acceptably but the layer tree is misleading.
looseEnds.ask: Give the field a fill width so it does not hug its value.
